_comment: Device types the onboarding wizard can provision. The landing page renders
one tile per entry, so adding a supported device is adding an entry here —
not editing the server or the page.
id          stable slug; what /api/start is called with
status      'available' renders a working tile; anything else renders
disabled with the status as its label
script      path relative to the repo root, executable, run with
connection  how the device attaches during onboarding (shown on the tile)
roles       what the script can onboard the device AS. The role is chosen
inside the run, not here: it is the wizard's first question,
because a unit/zone holds one and only one SENSE and one and
only one CONTROL and the free slots differ per role.
The 'planned' entries below are illustrative placeholders. Delete them or
replace them with real ones; nothing depends on them existing.

devices.name: ESP32 / ESP32-S3
devices.subtitle: MicroPython SENSE or CONTROL board
devices.description: Erases the board, flashes a pinned MicroPython build, joins it to WiFi from its own radio scan, gives it a unit/zone slot from the platform database, ships the application for its role with the pins you choose, and registers it as the device in that slot.

devices.name: ESP32-S3 + OV2640
devices.subtitle: Zone camera
devices.description: Needs a vendor firmware build with the camera driver compiled in — the generic MicroPython image has no camera module.

devices.name: Modbus RTU gateway
devices.subtitle: Third-party sensors and drives
devices.description: Onboards equipment that speaks Modbus rather than MQTT, by registering a polling profile instead of flashing firmware.
